name: Nyai Ratri
bio: Ratri brokers the Tuban Moon's rice from a rented yard in Upeh. She knows what the boatmen carry but will not speak for what they were paid to forget.
notes: fact: Tuban supplied rice to Melaka, and Upeh housed a large Javanese community (docs/research/commodities.md, Rice; docs/research/1511-events.md, assault on Melaka)

gameplay: The Tuban Moon is a Tuban jong carrying rice. Ratri is a design candidate for the unnamed broker in the Kim Hong follow-up, not established there as the owner of Hamzah's nutmeg (data/briefings/day_04_rumours_from_the_west.json; data/events/ev_kim_hong_owner_plea.json)

gameplay: Protect a boatman's testimony and Ratri will introduce the shahbandar to the buyer who rented a corner of her yard. Publicly name her on hearsay and the yard closes just when the rice market needs it (data/events/ev_kim_hong_whispers.json; docs/gameplay-blueprint.md §09)
